pr-workflow.rationale: With merge_strategy=pr, gt done opens a GitHub pull request for no-merge tasks and the Refinery can wait for approval and merge worker pull requests through the provider API (v1.2.1). Not tested. Scope: Gas Town CLI and Refinery.

telemetry-opt-out.rationale: Telemetry export is off unless an OTLP endpoint env var is set; leaving it unset disables it. Scope: Gas Town v1.2.1.
